## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's compact "roving reflections" (*yóu yì*) on *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)), paralleling his *Huāyán yóu yì* 華嚴遊意 ([KR6e0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0002), T1731) and similar *yóu yì* works on other major Mahāyāna sūtras. The genre is one of Jízàng's distinctive literary contributions.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (595–623) reflects Jízàng's mature Suí period.
